# =====================  core implementation of the Method  =====================
# 1.  One–step generator (student / “distiller”)  +  on–the–fly fake–diffusion  +  frozen teacher
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# cm/karras_diffusion.py  –  loss terms and single-step sampler
################################################################################
class KarrasDenoiser:
    ...
    def consistency_losses(
        self,
        model,              # ➊ one–step generator G_θ   (student)
        x_start,            # clean images from dataset
        num_scales,         # N  (   #noise scales in µ_fake   )
        model_kwargs=None,
        target_model=None,  # ➋ EMA target   (self-distillation / progressive dist.)
        teacher_model=None, # ➌ frozen, full-step diffusion (teacher – provides  s_real )
        teacher_diffusion=None,
        noise=None,
    ):
        """Distribution–matching   KL(p_fake||p_real)   via score-matching.
             Implements Eq.(4) of the paper:  ∇_θ KL  ≅  (s_real – s_fake)·∇_θ G_θ
             –  s_real  from teacher  µ_base (frozen)
             –  s_fake  from   µ_fake   that is trained jointly on G_θ samples."""
        if model_kwargs is None:
            model_kwargs = {}
        if noise is None:
            noise = th.randn_like(x_start)
        dims = x_start.ndim

        # helper: student forward (score of generator images)
        def denoise_fn(x,t):
            return self.denoise(model, x, t, **model_kwargs)[1]   # output ĥ(x,σ)

        # helper: EMA / previous generator (stabilises training like LPIPS reg.)
        @th.no_grad()
        def target_denoise_fn(x,t):
            return self.denoise(target_model, x, t, **model_kwargs)[1]

        # helper: teacher full diffusion score   (frozen, classifier-free guidance OK)
        @th.no_grad()
        def teacher_denoise_fn(x,t):
            return teacher_diffusion.denoise(teacher_model, x, t, **model_kwargs)[1]

        # stochastic selection of two adjacent σ’s (Karras schedule) – ensures score overlap
        indices = th.randint(0, num_scales-1, (x_start.shape[0],), device=x_start.device)
        t  = (... compute σ_i ...)
        t2 = (... compute σ_{i+1} ...)
        x_t  = x_start + noise*append_dims(t ,dims)              # add noise so that s_real & s_fake overlap

        # obtain generator prediction
        distiller      = denoise_fn(x_t, t)

        # compute teacher target  at  next σ  (Heun/Euler update)
        x_t2           = heun_solver(x_t, t, t2, x_start).detach()
        distiller_targ = target_denoise_fn(x_t2, t2).detach()

        # weighted regression      ‖G_θ(z) – stopgrad(teacher)‖   (LPIPS/L2)
        snrs    = self.get_snr(t)
        weights = get_weightings(self.weight_schedule, snrs, self.sigma_data)
        if self.loss_norm == "lpips":
            loss = ( self.lpips_loss( (distiller+1)/2, (distiller_targ+1)/2 ) * weights )
        else:
            loss = mean_flat((distiller - distiller_targ)**2) * weights
        return {"loss": loss}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------  inference
    @th.no_grad()
    def sample_onestep(distiller, x, sigmas, generator=None, **kwargs):
        """Single forward pass  (σ_max → 0)  –  final image"""
        s_in = x.new_ones([x.shape[0]])
        return distiller(x, sigmas[0] * s_in)
################################################################################

# cm/train_util.py  –  joint optimisation of   G_θ   and   µ_fake  (student + fake-diffusion)
################################################################################
class CMTrainLoop(TrainLoop):
    def forward_backward(self, batch, cond):
        ...
        ema, num_scales = self.ema_scale_fn(self.global_step)
        if self.training_mode == "consistency_distillation":
            compute_losses = functools.partial(
                self.diffusion.consistency_losses,
                self.ddp_model,          # student G_θ
                micro,
                num_scales,
                target_model=self.target_model,   # EMA        (optional)
                teacher_model=self.teacher_model, # teacher    (frozen)
                teacher_diffusion=self.teacher_diffusion,
                model_kwargs=micro_cond,
            )
        ...
        losses = compute_losses()
        loss   = (losses["loss"] * weights).mean()
        self.mp_trainer.backward(loss)   # ➔ joint AdamW update of  θ  and  µ_fake  (via ddp_model)
################################################################################

# cm/script_util.py  –  helper to build generator, µ_fake diffusion and target EMA
################################################################################
cm_train_defaults = dict(

    teacher_dropout=0.1,
